outcome: Mortality (at 7 days, 21 days, and at discharge)
cohort: Extremely low birth weight (ELBW) neonates with proven infection born from January 2008 to December 2014.
finding: ELBW infants with proven sepsis treated with IgMeIVIG had a significantly lower short-term (7 and 21 day) mortality compared with neonates receiving antibiotics alone.
mod_finding: While mode of delivery was recorded, this study found no significant difference in outcomes for extremely low birth weight infants with sepsis based on mode of delivery.
